object.attr: analysis: without it, a link that MELLON-TRACE-SRS-52 makes suspect is acknowledged with the same 7 digits again and can't become OK. Requirements review Q2. Holds until MELLON-TRACE-SRS-55 replaces it. Answered on 2026-11-10.
object.description: When Mellon records an acknowledged commit, Mellon shall record the shortest leading part of the commit's hash, at least 7 hexadecimal digits long, that begins no other commit's hash.
